text:
maria: Heads up — after last night's RBAC refactor some on-prem superusers lost the ability to rotate KMS keys and access audit logs. Two customer support tickets opened.

tj: Confirmed. Getting 403 from private control plane on `/v1/kms/rotate` with `error: access denied: role=priv-admin missing permission kms.rotate`. Seen across two tenants.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 created (sev: high) — assigned to @maria, @tj.

sam: Did we rename the role from `priv-admin` -> `privileged-admin` in the refactor? We added an alias in code but I think role-mapper didn't load aliases when VPC allowlist is enabled.

ting: I'm tailing role-mapper logs now. Saw a nil pointer while loading role aliases when `allowlist.enabled=true` for tenant `acme-corp`. stack: `roleMapper.LoadAliases -> allowlist.Validate -> panic: runtime error: invalid memory address`

leila: If that's the path, short-term mitigation is to inject a compatibility binding for affected orgs: add `priv-admin` -> `privileged-admin` alias in the role-mapper config for those tenants. Example patch: ```kubectl patch configmap role-mapper -n controlplane --patch '{"data":{"roleAliases":"priv-admin:privileged-admin"}}'```

ankur: Prefer canary first — don't patch prod global config. Deploy alias to dedicated staging control plane, test with a tenant that has VPC allowlist on/off combos.

maria: Agreed. I'll notify support with a short message to impacted customers: "we're investigating; workaround is temporary binding by our team; expect update in 2 hours."

tj: Short mitigation command (ops-only): `redwood-cli rbac grant --org acme-corp --role priv-admin --scope org --reason "temp rotation fix"` — that creates a binding bypassing role-mapper until patch. Use sparingly.

leila: I'll open a PR with the fix + unit tests to ensure alias loading doesn't touch allowlist validation path. Also adding an integration test: start control plane with `ALLOWLIST=true` and a role alias payload.

ops-bot: Deploybot: role-mapper v2.1.1-canary pushed to staging (sha: 7bd3a1f).

maria: Owner assignments: leila (fix + PR), tj (canary + rollout plan), sam (validation + customer verification).

ting: Canary logs look clean after the patch — alias loads, no panic. Running e2e against a proxied tenant now.

tj: Rolling to 3 pilot tenants in prod (non-critical) with monitoring on `/v1/kms/rotate` 1m success rate and audit-read latency.

ops-bot: Monitoring alert cleared for pilot tenants.

maria: Patch merged to main. Rollout to prod started (rolling update). Please avoid manual RBAC changes while rollout in progress.

tj: Patch (7bd3a1f) applied to prod control planes. Verified `curl -X POST https://private.cp/redwood/v1/kms/rotate -H "Authorization: Bearer ..."` returns 200 for affected superusers.

sam: Customer confirmations: two customers reported rotation succeeded after temporary binding + subsequent patch. Support notified them incident resolved.

maria: Root cause summary: alias loader called allowlist validation in a non-idempotent path; when allowlist config was present but incomplete it triggered a nil read and skipped alias registration, effectively removing `priv-admin` mapping. Fix ensures alias loader is independent and has safe nil checks.

leila: Follow-ups: add e2e for VPC allowlist + alias combos, add an alert for any role-mapper panic, and document the temporary CLI mitigation. I'll file a short runbook.

ankur: +1 on runbook. Also recommend an automated smoke for critical RPCs (kms.rotate, audit.read) after RBAC deploys.

maria: Closing incident after 24h stable. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
